typed_core.name: provisional_document_subtype
typed_core.why: processor — model's best guess at the real type; drives reclassification
typed_core.prompt_hint: This is a fallback classification — the model's most useful output is provisional_document_subtype: name the document type this should be so a human can reclassify

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: disambiguator — issuer header when distinct from issuer_or_creator

typed_core.name: document_purpose_or_category
typed_core.why: processor — what the document is for (CORE)

typed_core.name: effective_or_coverage_period
typed_core.why: identity; the period it covers, if any

typed_core.name: party_name
typed_core.why: identity — named party to attach to a borrower (flattened from parties_named person_orentity[])

typed_core.name: parties_named_raw
typed_core.why: disambiguator — verbatim party string so a bad split stays visible

typed_core.name: property_orloan_reference
typed_core.why: identity linkage — ties to a property/loan when stated

typed_core.name: account_case_or_reference_number
typed_core.why: PII candidate (restricted) — reference/account number; identity + dedup key
typed_core.prompt_hint: Treat any number that could be an SSN/account number as sensitive and route it to the typed identifier field, never the catch-all

typed_core.name: status_or_outcome
typed_core.why: processor — disposition, if the document reports one

nested_lists.name: key_value_pairs
nested_lists.shape_reason: because the document is unclassified, its content is best captured as generic {key, value} rows rather than a bespoke typed structure — a flat row per pair is light and adapts to any layout; flat-row is the safe default under the 16,384-token ceiling

fields.name: key
fields.why: the field label as it appears on the page

fields.name: value
fields.why: the field value; the correct home for the body of an unknown document

rejected.name: recommended_reclassification
rejected.reason: catalog TECHNICAL — a single-occurrence derived conclusion; the model's guess belongs in provisional_document_subtype, and reclassification is a downstream decision, not an extracted fact (tags describe, rules judge)

rejected.name: amounts_and_dates, narrative_sections, tables_orline_items, signatures_seals_or_certifications, attachments_or_referenced_documents
rejected.reason: no consumer; body captured by key_value_pairs + catch-all

encoding_variations: Because the type is unknown, document_title, provisional_document_subtype, and document_purpose_or_category may all restate the same thing in different words — keep all three so a human can reclassify from whichever the issuer used.
Identifiers may be labeled 'Case #', 'Ref', 'Account', 'Policy', 'Permit' — capture the label with the value.

open_questions.q: key_value_pairs item count. Unknown by definition.
options: flat-row + one source with a hard cap (e.g. 50 pairs)
open_questions.recommendation: flat-row + one source and a hard cap to stay under the token ceiling; flag if documents routinely exceed that

register in _PII_FIELDS (pre_masked false — the model cannot reliably pre-mask an unknown identifier; the snapshot masks raw). This is the highest-risk unmasked-PII path in the whole packet because the doc type is unknown GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: How much to type at all. A misc document arguably needs only identity + key_value_pairs.
options: keep the extra CORE fields (document_purpose, status_or_outcome)
open_questions.recommendation: kept for reclassification; confirm they earn their tokens or drop to catch-all GEET'S DECISION (LP-439): keep the extra fields (they earn their tokens for reclassification).

notes: No rules in the packet → no rule floor. This is the catch-all document type — anything classification could not place. Its schema's real job is to capture enough identity to (a) let a human reclassify it and (b) attach it to a borrower/property/loan. Deep typed extraction is inappropriate because the content is unknown; the body goes to key_value_pairs and the catch-all. Every field is justified by identity or processor review.

account_case_or_reference_number — catalog restricted. On a truly unknown document this could be an account number, a case number, or a policy number. Recommend registering it in _PII_FIELDS (pre_masked false). Unregistered ⇒ a real account number could land unmasked in the catch-all. This is the single most important PII decision for the catch-all doc type.
Named parties are personal names — retained as typed identity fields.
Prompt hint (doc-level): do not invent structure. Capture what is on the page as key_value_pairs; do not force it into a schema for a type it may not be.
